title: Identity token verification and protect-by-default API

tasks.title: Verify Sefaria identity tokens against the configured JWKS
Protect every API route by default, with an explicit public list

acs.text: WHEN a request to a protected route carries `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where the token is an RS256 JWT whose `kid` names a key in the configured JWKS, whose `iss` equals the configured issuer, whose `aud` is `sefaria-social`, which is unexpired, and whose `sub` is a positive integer, THE SYSTEM SHALL run the handler as Sefaria user `sub` with the token's `name`, `picture` and `staff` claims.
scenarios: A valid Sefaria token identifies the caller

acs.text: WHEN the token is missing, malformed, expired, signed by a key not in the JWKS, signed with another algorithm (for example HS256), has the wrong issuer or audience, or has a `sub` that is not a positive integer, THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 401 with error code `auth.missing_token` (no token) or `auth.invalid_token` (any other case) and SHALL NOT run the handler.
scenarios: Invalid tokens are refused before the handler runs

acs.text: WHEN the JWKS cannot be fetched within 3 seconds THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 503 with `auth.unavailable`; WHEN keys were fetched once THE SYSTEM SHALL reuse them for later tokens without fetching again, and SHALL refetch when a token names an unknown `kid`.
scenarios: An unreachable JWKS makes protected routes unavailable, not open
Keys are cached and refetched for an unknown kid

acs.text: WHEN any route the server serves under `/api/` is called without credentials THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse it with 401, except the routes on the explicit public list (today only `GET /api/v1/health`); a test enumerates every route in the served route tree and checks this.
scenarios: Every non-public API route refuses anonymous callers

acs.text: WHEN an endpoint is declared public but its method and path are not on the public list THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse to define it (an error at module load naming the endpoint), so a route cannot be made public by accident.
scenarios: An endpoint cannot be public by accident
